title: What are generics in C# and why are they useful?
description: Learn type-safe generic programming in C#.

data.text: **Question:** What are generics in C# and why are they useful?
Generics allow you to define classes, methods, and interfaces with a placeholder for the type. They provide type safety without sacrificing performance, eliminating the need for boxing and casting.

**Benefits of Generics:**
- **Type Safety:** Compile-time type checking
- **Performance:** No boxing for value types
- **Code Reuse:** Single implementation works for multiple types
- **No Casting:** Eliminates runtime type errors

**Common Generic Types:**
- List<T>, Dictionary<TKey, TValue>
- IEnumerable<T>, IQueryable<T>
- Action<T>, Func<T, TResult>
- Nullable<T>
